title: Deep whole-exome sequencing of NA12878 (HG001) on three platforms for germline variant-calling benchmarking: analysis framework and processed results
description:
Analysis framework and processed benchmarking outputs for deep whole-exome sequencing of NA12878/HG001 on Illumina NovaSeq 6000, BGI DNBSEQ-T7 and GeneMind SURFSeq 5000.

Version 1.1.0 replaces the 66 formal GPU HaplotypeCaller runs with the 2026-11-05 rerun using the same V6 capture target BED for CPU and GPU base quality score recalibration. The GPU BQSR steps use zero additional interval padding.

The package contains 5,448 benchmark rows covering 454 archived run identifiers. Analyses use 450 runs and 132 matched CPU and GPU pairs. Four acceptance runs and two acceptance pairs are retained as historical records and excluded from analyses. Contents include run identity and coverage, calling and total wall-clock times, direct variant concordance and quality summaries, sequencing and identity QC, target BED files for GRCh38 and GRCh37/b37, 15 figure/table source-data CSV files and figure code. Revision provenance includes the affected run list, target BED checksum, BQSR protocol, stage timings and previous affected records.

Raw reads are in NCBI SRA BioProject PRJNA1506792, study SRP723789, BioSample SAMN62149305, runs SRR39986367, SRR39986368 and SRR39986369. Raw reads and GIAB truth VCFs are obtained from their original repositories.
